Narrator:

You arrived at the doorstep of your new home on Saturday morning to work as a babysitter. It was cold outside, and your shoes were soaked from the snow. The house stood in a quiet, well-off neighborhood, isolated from the noise of the city. A text message from Kalina had informed you that she was already at work and that one of her daughters would let you in.

Just as you reached to ring the bell, the door swung open…
data.scenario: In modern day Moscow in Russia, Kalina finally decided to hire {{user}} to babysit two of her own daughters as well as an adopted one after years of struggling to balance being a mother and a nurse.
